items.title: Show HN: Bor – Open-source policy management for Linux desktops
items.title_zh: Bor v0.8：面向Linux桌面的实时策略管理
items.title_en: Bor v0.8: Real-time policy management for Linux desktops
items.summary: Bor is an open-source system for centralized Linux desktop management using real-time mTLS/gRPC policy streaming, with v0.8 adding support for Thunderbird, Edge, and FirewallD.
